verdict.rationale: Babylon.js has the building blocks for scripted asset handling. It has a dedicated glTF importer deep-dive and multi-format loaders. It also offers server-side/headless execution via NullEngine, which lets loader code run in scripts outside a browser. DCC exporter plugins for 3ds Max, Maya and Blender feed assets in. However, the evidence never documents import hooks, presets or batch pipeline scripts that process incoming assets automatically. Automation would have to be hand-built on top of the loader APIs. missing for 10: documented import hooks/post-processing callbacks, import presets, batch/CLI pipeline tooling, hands-on corroboration of automated asset processing.
